paragraphs.text: The Evincar's Quarters are part of the Stronghold of Rath , located near the top of the structure. The Stronghold was later shifted to Urborg on Dominaria .

Of all of Volrath ’s sanctums, there was one that Gerrard Capashen did not find: the evincar ’s quarters. Few have ever seen the interior of these chambers, and to many who work in the stronghold, the exact location of the rooms is a matter of speculation.

The quarters are not merely the evincar's sanctum; they house those machines not trusted to anyone else to operate. Among them was the machine that could monitor activities almost anywhere on Rath , allowing the evincar to stretch his control over flowstone to every corner of Rath. Additionally, there existed a machine that monitored the planar barrier that enwrapped Rath, which was the only device known that could accurately predict where new breaches into Dominaria would occur — a process that almost everyone else believed to be random. Rumors persist that a small planar portal resided within the chambers for the evincar’s personal use. Whether it led to multiple planes or just one was pure speculation.
During the Rathi Overlay , the Evincar's Quarters shifted with the rest of the Stronghold to Urborg on Dominaria , but it is not known if they were destroyed in the process.
